clips.text: Mind means duality and meditation, oneness.
In Zen they call it - The One Sword.

Kusunoki Masashige came to a Zen monastery when he was about to meet the oncoming army of Ashikaga Takanji, and asked the master: When a man is at the parting of the ways between life and death, how should he behave?
The master answered: Cut off your dualism and let the one sword stand serenely by itself against the sky!
